citation_snapshot_surface_label: Example live-vs-citation-head posture for mutable official voter-information pages
delivery_role_note: Bounded citation-discipline review surface for mutable official pages that are likely to be cited or summarized by search, AI, chatbots, media, or partner explainers.

operational_head_routes.current_state_cue: Current election date range and last-updated cue remain visible on the live page.
Current cycle, office, and temporary-change notice context remain visible on the live page.

citation_head_artifacts.head_relationship_note: The current live page supersedes the cited March 18 snapshot for day-of updates but the snapshot remains the exact point-in-time citation head for earlier references.

live_vs_citation_head_note: The office distinguishes the current live operational head from the latest public citation-safe head and does not imply exact point-in-time citation certainty when only a mutable live page exists.
snapshot_generation_policy_note: Action-changing pages likely to be quoted or summarized receive bounded point-in-time capture artifacts when their exact public state needs later reconstruction.
preview_queue_boundary_note: Preview URLs, CMS staging copies, and review-queue artifacts are explicitly non-public and are never treated as public citation heads.
superseding_citation_head_note: When a newer public citation head replaces an older one, the relationship is expressed as superseding/correcting/updating rather than left to inference.
quote_or_ai_citation_recovery_note: When search, AI, hotline, or media summaries point to a mutable official page, the office can identify whether that live page was also the citation-safe head and where the point-in-time snapshot lives if not.
